implementation: Actual Android instrumentation of baseline Kotlin app; not a replica
productionChanges: None. app/src/main files hash-verified against isolated copy before build; see results/production-source-sha256.json

scenarioSemantics.timeoutAfterCommit: Fake CityApi commits one request, throws IOException before returning response; real submitRequest writes fallback local row, real refreshRequests imports committed row. Two IDs for one intent. No second submit required.
scenarioSemantics.preCommitFailure: Fake CityApi throws before commit, then recovers; five real refreshRequests calls. One local row persists with status Created (Russian production string), zero server requests, create call count remains one. This is loss of automatic delivery/retry, NOT deletion of the pending row or permanent data loss.
scenarioSemantics.multiuser: Real Room DAO seeded with five user1 and five user2 records; real loadLocalRequests called while AppState userId=1; counts foreign-user rows returned. No API used for this scenario.
scenarioSemantics.concurrentRefresh: Fifty trials per run. Reset real in-memory Room row to Created; fake API returns same ID with changed status. Release two Dispatchers.IO calls to real refreshRequests from common CompletableDeferred gate; count real AppState notifications. No hooks into DAO or production refresh logic. Race probability depends on scheduler.
scenarioSemantics.historyDao: On-disk production Room initialized by MainActivity; 100 or 1000 deterministic records inserted individually before timing; 10 sequential loadLocalRequests calls per dataset per run. Includes real DAO read and mapping; excludes seeding and UI.
scenarioSemantics.historyUi: Real MainActivity/CityServicesApp/RequestsScreen. From before clicking My Requests to UiAutomator observing newest fixture comment. Includes click overhead, local DAO read, composition, accessibility observation; does not require all 1000 rows to be simultaneously rendered. Fake API swapped after catalog appears to prevent polling changing fixture.
scenarioSemantics.instrumentedLaunch: From startActivity call to visible login demo-fill control. Instrumentation process already running; not cold process launch. Production MainActivity initializes locator and restores session normally.
scenarioSemantics.loginCatalog: Demo credentials UI, real production FakeApi login and catalog delays; waits for My Requests and first service title containing Cleanup in Russian. UiAutomator observation includes automation latency.
scenarioSemantics.coldLaunch: After instrumentation runs, clear ONLY isolated baseline app once; five force-stop + am start -W launches. Host stopwatch starts before am start. Login readiness is observed by uiautomator XML dump containing isolated package and RUT demo hint. This is an upper-bound observed readiness including adb/UI dump latency, not an exact first-frame timestamp. am start output retained separately; TotalTime is NOT UI readiness.
scenarioSemantics.scroll: Reset gfxinfo before entering 1000-row history, wait newest row, execute 20 upward UiDevice swipes (20 steps each), dump gfxinfo framestats. Includes screen entry plus scrolling, not scroll-only. Raw output repeats overall and per-window summary; do not sum duplicate summary blocks.
scenarioSemantics.memory: Same instrumentation/target process, Debug.MemoryInfo PSS plus Runtime used heap before and after 20 services-history-services cycles; samples every five cycles. Begins after 1000-row scroll. No forced GC, no heap dump. Not evidence sufficient to establish or exclude a memory leak. Not release standalone process PSS.

limitations: Single emulator, debug build, instrumentation overhead; not representative device fleet or release performance.
Fault injection uses test CityApi implementing production interface, not real HTTP packet loss.
Three scenario measurements and thirty DAO reads per dataset; no confidence interval claim.
No permanent data loss claim: unsubmitted local pending row survives recovery refreshes.
Original production package/data not cleared, uninstalled or modified. Only isolated baseline package installed and cleared. No commit/push.
